title: Raptor Finding Schema
description: Schema for security findings in Raptor audit framework

title.description: Finding title in format: {actor} will {impact} {affected party}

summary.description: Summary with structure: {root cause} will cause [a/an] {impact} for {affected party} as {actor} will {attack path}

root_cause.description: The fundamental issue - either code location or design flaw

internal_preconditions.description: System state requirements for the vulnerability to be exploitable

external_preconditions.description: External protocol conditions needed for exploitation

mitigation.description: Recommended fixes to address the vulnerability
